label: L1s
content:
L1s = (
{
  num_cc = 1;                              // Number of supported Component Carriers (here single carrier).
  tr_n_preference = "local_mac";           // Preferred transport between L1 and MAC layer using local IPC.
  prach_dtx_threshold = 130;               // DTX threshold for PRACH in subframes. If UE doesn’t respond in time, gNB considers RACH failed.
  pucch0_dtx_threshold = 80;               // DTX threshold for PUCCH format 0. No uplink control signal beyond this means UE is lost.
  pusch_dtx_threshold = 10;                // DTX threshold for PUSCH (uplink shared channel), likely in TTI.
  max_ldpc_iterations = 10;                // Max decoding iterations for LDPC (Low Density Parity Check). Higher is more accurate but costly.
  tx_amp_backoff_dB = 20;                  // Transmission power backoff (dB), protects PA and aligns with O-RU config. **Must match O-RU** to avoid signal issues.
  L1_rx_thread_core = 8;                   // Assign CPU core for physical layer RX thread (core 8 here).
  L1_tx_thread_core = 10;                  // Assign CPU core for physical layer TX thread (core 10). Helps reduce context switching and boost performance.
  phase_compensation = 0;                  // Phase compensation switch, 0 is off. Should match O-RU. If on, gNB adjusts phase based on O-RU feedback.
}
);

label: fhi_72
content:
fhi_72 = {
  dpdk_devices = ("0000:ca:02.0", "0000:ca:02.1");   // PCI addresses of DPDK NICs used for DU <-> RU data transmission.
  system_core = 0;   // System core used for binding main process or control flow.
  io_core = 4;  // IO core used for network I/O (e.g., packet TX/RX).
  worker_cores = (2);  // Worker cores for processing data plane tasks (multiple allowed).
  du_addr = ("00:11:22:33:44:66", "00:11:22:33:44:66");   // MAC addresses of DU (dual-port setup for full-duplex or redundancy).
  ru_addr = ("10:70:fd:14:1c:10", "10:70:fd:14:1c:10");   // MAC addresses of the physical RU devices.
  mtu = 1500;   // MTU setting, usually 1500 (standard Ethernet frame size).
  file_prefix = "fhi_72";   // Prefix for DPDK memory region naming to avoid conflict among instances.

  # FrontHaul (FHI) time parameter setting block
  fh_config = ({

    Tadv_cp_dl = 125;    // Advance time for downlink control plane (unit: ns).
    T2a_cp_dl = (259, 470);    // DL control plane DU -> RU max/min delay (ns).
    T2a_cp_ul = (125, 1200);    // UL control plane RU -> DU max/min delay (ns).
    T2a_up = (70, 345);    // UL user plane RU -> DU max/min delay (ns).
    Ta3 = (50, 171);    // Time from DU receiving data to passing it to L1 (ns).
    T1a_cp_dl = (258, 392);    // DL control plane DU processing time (DU to MAC packet send) in ns.
    T1a_cp_ul = (285, 300);    // UL control plane DU processing time (ns).
    T1a_up = (155, 300);    // UL user plane DU processing time (ns).
    Ta4 = (0, 200);    // RU forwarding delay after receiving data (ns).

    ru_config = {
      iq_width = 9;           // IQ data width (9 bits indicates compressed format).
      iq_width_prach = 9;     // IQ data width used for PRACH.
      fft_size = 12;          // FFT size (log2(N), N=2^12=4096; corresponds to 273 RBs).
    };

gNBs =
(
 {
    ////////// Identification parameters:
    gNB_ID    = 0xe01;             // gNB identifier (customizable), used to uniquely identify the gNB. This is 0xE01.
    gNB_name  = "gNB-OAI";         // Name of the gNB, for identification only with no protocol function.

    // Tracking area code, 0x0000 and 0xfffe are reserved values
    tracking_area_code  =  1;        // TAC (Tracking Area Code), used by the core network to identify the area (similar to LAC).

    plmn_list = ({ mcc = 001 ;mnc = 01 mnc_length = 2 snssaiList = ( { sst = 1 })})
    # Mobile Country Code (MCC), here set to 001 (for testing).
    # Mobile Network Code (MNC), here set to 01.
    # MNC length is 2 digits (some MNCs use 3 digits).
    # snssaiList: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information, SST=1 indicates eMBB service type.
 

    nr_cellid = 1;  // NR Cell ID used to differentiate between gNB cells.

    ////////// Physical parameters:
    pdsch_AntennaPorts_XP = 2;     // Number of antenna ports for PDSCH (downlink shared channel), here is 2.
    pusch_AntennaPorts    = 2;     // Number of antenna ports for PUSCH (uplink shared channel), also 2.
    do_CSIRS              = 1;     // Whether CSI-RS (Channel State Information Reference Signal) is enabled, 1 means enabled.
    do_SRS                = 0;     // Whether SRS (Sounding Reference Signal) is enabled, 0 means disabled.
    force_256qam_off      = 1;     // Whether to force disable 256QAM modulation, 1 means disabled (up to 64QAM allowed).
    sib1_tda              = 15;    // SIB1 time domain allocation, 15 refers to the TDA index.


    pdcch_ConfigSIB1 = (
      {
        controlResourceSetZero = 11; // Configuration index for CORESET#0, affects the PDCCH resource range.
        searchSpaceZero = 0; // Configuration index for SearchSpace#0, affects where UE receives PDCCH.
      }
    );

label: security
content:
security = {
  # preferred ciphering algorithms
  # the first one of the list that an UE supports in chosen
  # valid values: nea0, nea1, nea2, nea3
  ciphering_algorithms = ( "nea0" ); // Set to nea0, meaning no encryption (plain text transmission).

  # preferred integrity algorithms
  # the first one of the list that an UE supports in chosen
  # valid values: nia0, nia1, nia2, nia3
  integrity_algorithms = ( "nia2", "nia0" ); // Prefer AES for integrity protection; fallback to none (nia0) if UE doesn't support.
  # setting 'drb_ciphering' to "no" disables ciphering for DRBs, no matter
  # what 'ciphering_algorithms' configures; same thing for 'drb_integrity'
  drb_ciphering = "yes"; // Ciphering enabled for DRBs (unless nea0 is selected).
  drb_integrity = "no";  // Disable DRB integrity protection (saves compute but reduces security).
};

servingCellConfigCommon = (
    {
 #spCellConfigCommon

      physCellId = 0;   // Physical cell ID, range 0~1007, used to identify the cell.
     # n_TimingAdvanceOffset = 0;  // Timing advance offset, usually not manually configured
#  downlinkConfigCommon
    #frequencyInfoDL
      # this is 3450.72 MHz (center frequency)
      absoluteFrequencySSB                                          = 630048; // SSB center frequency, approx. 3450.72 MHz (see TS 38.104 Table 5.4.2.1-1).
      dl_frequencyBand                                              = 78;  // Band number, n78 represents 3.3GHz~3.8GHz.
      # this is 3401.58 MHz
      dl_absoluteFrequencyPointA                                    = 626772; // Absolute frequency of Point A, approx. 3401.58 MHz.
      #scs-SpecificCarrierList
        dl_offstToCarrier                                           = 0; // Frequency offset relative to Point A.
# subcarrierSpacing
# 0=kHz15, 1=kHz30, 2=kHz60, 3=kHz120
        dl_subcarrierSpacing                                        = 1; // Downlink subcarrier spacing is 30kHz.
        dl_carrierBandwidth                                         = 273; // Downlink bandwidth (273 Resource Blocks).
     #initialDownlinkBWP
      #genericParameters
       initialDLBWPlocationAndBandwidth                             = 1099; #38.101-1 Table 5.3.2-1 // Initial BWP location and bandwidth (see TS 38.101-1 Table 5.3.2-1).
       #
# subcarrierSpacing
# 0=kHz15, 1=kHz30, 2=kHz60, 3=kHz120
        initialDLBWPsubcarrierSpacing                               = 1; // Initial downlink BWP subcarrier spacing is 30kHz.

      #pdcch-ConfigCommon
        initialDLBWPcontrolResourceSetZero                          = 11; // ControlResourceSet ID
        initialDLBWPsearchSpaceZero                                 = 0;  // SearchSpace ID

  #uplinkConfigCommon
     #frequencyInfoUL
      ul_frequencyBand                                              = 78; // Uplink band, same as downlink: n78
      #scs-SpecificCarrierList
      ul_offstToCarrier                                             = 0; // Offset is 0 when UL shares DL band
# subcarrierSpacing
# 0=kHz15, 1=kHz30, 2=kHz60, 3=kHz120
      ul_subcarrierSpacing                                          = 1; // Uplink subcarrier spacing is 30kHz
      ul_carrierBandwidth                                           = 273; // Uplink bandwidth is 273 RBs
      pMax                                                          = 23; // UE max transmit power (dBm)
     #initialUplinkBWP
      #genericParameters
        initialULBWPlocationAndBandwidth                            = 1099; // Initial UL BWP bandwidth and location
# subcarrierSpacing
# 0=kHz15, 1=kHz30, 2=kHz60, 3=kHz120
        initialULBWPsubcarrierSpacing                               = 1; // Uplink subcarrier spacing is 30kHz
      #rach-ConfigCommon
        #rach-ConfigGeneric
          prach_ConfigurationIndex                                  = 151; // PRACH config index (TS 38.211 Table 6.3.3.2-2)
#prach_msg1_FDM
#0 = one, 1=two, 2=four, 3=eight
          prach_msg1_FDM                                            = 0; // Number of FDM for Msg1, 0 = 1 unit
          prach_msg1_FrequencyStart                                 = 0; // Start frequency position of Msg1
          zeroCorrelationZoneConfig                                 = 0; // ZCZ configuration, affects PRACH sequence selection
          preambleReceivedTargetPower                               = -100; // Target received power of preamble (dBm)
#preamblTransMax (0...10) = (3,4,5,6,7,8,10,20,50,100,200)
          preambleTransMax                                          = 7; // Max number of preamble transmissions (value 7 = 20 times)
#powerRampingStep
# 0=dB0,1=dB2,2=dB4,3=dB6
        powerRampingStep                                            = 3; // Power ramping step (6 dB)
#ra_ReponseWindow
#1,2,4,8,10,20,40,80
        ra_ResponseWindow                                           = 5; // RA response window (value 5 = 20 slots)
#ssb_perRACH_OccasionAndCB_PreamblesPerSSB_PR
#1=oneeighth,2=onefourth,3=half,4=one,5=two,6=four,7=eight,8=sixteen
        ssb_perRACH_OccasionAndCB_PreamblesPerSSB_PR                = 3; // Ratio of contention-based preambles per SSB (3 = half)
#oneHalf (0..15) 4,8,12,16,...60,64
        ssb_perRACH_OccasionAndCB_PreamblesPerSSB                   = 15; // Number of contention-based preambles per SSB
#ra_ContentionResolutionTimer
#(0..7) 8,16,24,32,40,48,56,64
        ra_ContentionResolutionTimer                                = 7;  // Contention resolution timer (value 7 = 64ms)
        rsrp_ThresholdSSB                                           = 19; // RSRP threshold for triggering RA (unit: dBm)
#prach-RootSequenceIndex_PR
#1 = 839, 2 = 139
        prach_RootSequenceIndex_PR                                  = 2; // Root sequence type, 2 = long sequence (139)
        prach_RootSequenceIndex                                     = 1; // Root sequence index for PRACH
        # SCS for msg1, can only be 15 for 30 kHz < 6 GHz, takes precendence over the one derived from prach-ConfigIndex
        #
        msg1_SubcarrierSpacing                                      = 1,
# restrictedSetConfig
# 0=unrestricted, 1=restricted type A, 2=restricted type B
        restrictedSetConfig                                         = 0,

# this is the offset between the last PRACH preamble power and the Msg3 PUSCH, 2 times the field value in dB
        msg3_DeltaPreamble                                          = 2; // Msg3 power offset from preamble (×2 → 4 dB)
        p0_NominalWithGrant                                         = -96; // Initial PUSCH power when grant is received

# pucch-ConfigCommon setup :
# pucchGroupHopping
# 0 = neither, 1= group hopping, 2=sequence hopping
        pucchGroupHopping                                           = 0; // PUCCH group hopping disabled.
        hoppingId                                                   = 0; // hopping ID
        p0_nominal                                                  = -96; // Initial PUCCH power.
# ssb_PositionsInBurs_BitmapPR
# 1=short, 2=medium, 3=long
      ssb_PositionsInBurst_PR                                       = 2; // SSB positioning type, 2=medium.
      ssb_PositionsInBurst_Bitmap                                   = 0x1; // Bitmap indicating SSB positions (first position enabled).

# ssb_periodicityServingCell
# 0 = ms5, 1=ms10, 2=ms20, 3=ms40, 4=ms80, 5=ms160, 6=spare2, 7=spare1
      ssb_periodicityServingCell                                    = 2; // SSB periodicity, 2 means 20ms.

# dmrs_TypeA_position
# 0 = pos2, 1 = pos3
      dmrs_TypeA_Position                                           = 0; // DMRS type A position, 0 = pos2

# subcarrierSpacing
# 0=kHz15, 1=kHz30, 2=kHz60, 3=kHz120
      subcarrierSpacing                                             = 1; // Overall subcarrier spacing is 30kHz


  #tdd-UL-DL-ConfigurationCommon
# subcarrierSpacing
# 0=kHz15, 1=kHz30, 2=kHz60, 3=kHz120
      referenceSubcarrierSpacing                                    = 1; // TDD reference subcarrier spacing = 30kHz
      # pattern1
      # dl_UL_TransmissionPeriodicity
      # 0=ms0p5, 1=ms0p625, 2=ms1, 3=ms1p25, 4=ms2, 5=ms2p5, 6=ms5, 7=ms10
      dl_UL_TransmissionPeriodicity                                 = 6;  // TDD period = 5ms
      nrofDownlinkSlots                                             = 7;  // Number of downlink slots per period
      nrofDownlinkSymbols                                           = 6;  // Number of OFDM symbols for downlink part (last slot is partial DL)
      nrofUplinkSlots                                               = 2;  // Number of uplink slots per period
      nrofUplinkSymbols                                             = 4;  // Number of OFDM symbols for uplink part (first slot is partial UL)

  ssPBCH_BlockPower                                                 = 10; // SS/PBCH block transmit power (dBm)
  }

  );

label: MACRLCs
content:
MACRLCs = (
{
  num_cc = 1;                      // Number of supported Component Carriers (here only 1 is enabled).
  tr_s_preference = "local_L1";    // Preferred transport channel between MAC and L1 (PHY), uses local IPC.
  tr_n_preference = "local_RRC";   // Preferred transport channel between MAC and RRC, uses local IPC.
  pusch_TargetSNRx10 = 300;        // Uplink PUSCH target SNR multiplied by 10 (actual 30 dB).
  pucch_TargetSNRx10 = 230;        // Uplink PUCCH (control channel) target SNR, actual is 23 dB.
  dl_bler_target_upper = .35;      // Upper limit of downlink BLER, MCS will be adjusted if exceeded.
  dl_bler_target_lower = .15;      // Lower limit of downlink BLER, MCS may be increased if below.
  ul_bler_target_upper = .35;      // Upper limit of uplink BLER.
  ul_bler_target_lower = .15;      // Lower limit of uplink BLER.
  pusch_FailureThres = 100;        // If uplink PUSCH repeatedly fails to this threshold, retransmission or drop may occur.
  ul_max_mcs = 28;                 // Maximum allowed MCS level for uplink (28 means 64QAM supported).
}
);
